credentialSubject.field9:
*** TEST / CALIBRATION DOCUMENT - NOT A SUBMISSION FOR ISSUANCE UNDER VERRA OR ANY OTHER PROGRAM ***

PURPOSE: exercise the VMR0015 / AMS-III.AV calculation engine against real-world project magnitudes, at the review team's request. This policy digitizes VERRA VMR0015 v1.0 (a Verra methodology) and is intended for Verra review. The test INPUT NUMBERS below are borrowed from published real-world projects purely to check engine arithmetic against realistic magnitudes - borrowing input numbers implies nothing about which registry reviews this policy.

PROVENANCE - two DISTINCT real projects are referenced; they must not be conflated:

(A) AMS-III.AV METHODOLOGY REFERENCE: CDM PoA 7067, 'Sustainable Deployment of the LifeStraw Family in rural INDONESIA', PoA ID 073P2XBYEUAGZML8S6NVJWFTHQ1KD5. Verified directly on the UNFCCC CDM registry (cdm.unfccc.int/ProgrammeOfActivities/poa_db/073P2XBYEUAGZML8S6NVJWFTHQ1KD5/view): Methodology Used = AMS-III.AV ver. 2; Registration Date = 30 Dec 2012; Sectoral scope 3 (Energy demand); Activity Scale = SMALL; DOE = DNV; Amount of Reductions = 52,674 tCO2e/annum. This is the genuine registered AMS-III.AV reference. NO parameters below are taken from it.

(B) SOURCE OF THE NUMERIC INPUTS: Vestergaard's SEPARATE Kenya 'Carbon for Water' LifeStraw project, certified under GOLD STANDARD's own cook-stove/kitchen-regime methodology - NOT under AMS-III.AV and NOT under Verra. Values used: population served 4,096,000; X_boil 0.71; fNRB 0.65; QPW_pp 4.11 L/person/day; Wi 0.36 kg wood/L; leakage ratio 0.00029453 (from that project's reported LE/BE = 736/2,498,872).

DERIVED (not reported by either project): field15 n_wb = 0.063654 and field16 EF_fuel = 116.7115 tCO2e/TJ. The Kenya PDD states fuel use as mass intensity (kg wood/L); AMS-III.AV Eq.1 requires the energy-based SEC/n_wb term, so n_wb was back-calculated by equating Wi x NCV(wood) to SEC/n_wb. The resulting 6.4% efficiency is consistent with published three-stone-fire values.

RESULT: engine computes BE_y = 1,858,686 tCO2e/yr against the Kenya project's reported 2,498,872 (74%). The residual gap is attributable to the cross-methodology unit conversion described above, not to an engine defect: the ER = BE - PE - LE structure reproduces that project's own reported figures exactly (2,498,872 - 424,808 - 736 = 2,073,328).

EXPLICIT DISCLAIMERS: (i) neither source project is Verra/VCS registered; (ii) no claim is made that either is VMR0015 registered; (iii) no credits are claimed by this document; (iv) for a like-for-like AMS-III.AV comparison, PoA 7067 publishes an ER calculation workbook built on AMS-III.AV meth v3 on its UNFCCC registry page.

implementationStatus.implementationStatus: 1,024,000 LifeStraw Family units distributed across 19 districts, Western Province, Kenya, per real PDD deployment record.

methodologyDeviations.deviationDescription: Physical input parameters sourced from a project certified under Gold Standard's cook-stove/kitchen-regime methodology - a DIFFERENT methodology, not an earlier version of AMS-III.AV. n_wb and EF_fuel therefore required unit conversion from that methodology's mass-based fuel intensity to AMS-III.AV's energy-based SEC/n_wb formulation.
methodologyDeviations.justification: Calibration testing only, at the request of the review team for realistic project magnitudes. The source of the parameters used a different certification program and methodology; this is disclosed rather than presented as an AMS-III.AV filing. For a definitive AMS-III.AV parameter set, CDM PoA 7067 (Indonesia) publishes an ER calculation workbook built on AMS-III.AV meth v3 on its UNFCCC registry page.
